records.speaker: Patron
records.clean_Japanese:
そう言えば、ご存じですか？
%sとかいう珍品を
%sで見た者が
いるとかいないとか…
records.context: A Tavern patron relays a rumor that someone saw a rare item. In the optional next panel, he doubts the drunk's word and suggests the listener may be able to make sense of the story.
records.english: Heard the rumor about a rare item? They say %s was seen in %s...
records.source_meaning: The patron asks if the listener heard a rumor that someone saw a rare item with this name in this region.
records.localization_note: They say keeps the report tentative and leads into the patron's optional warning. The first question stands alone, so the following line can keep the item name together.

records.speaker: Patron
records.clean_Japanese:
まあ、酔っぱらいの言うこと
ですから、信用はできませんがね
あなたほどの方なら
何か分かるかもしれません
records.context: A Tavern patron relays a rumor that someone saw a rare item. In the optional next panel, he doubts the drunk's word and suggests the listener may be able to make sense of the story.
records.english: It came from a drunk, so I wouldn't trust it. Still, someone like you might make sense of it.
records.source_meaning: The patron says the source is a drunk whose report cannot be trusted. The listener may understand what to make of it.
records.localization_note: The present voice shifts from distrust to qualified respect for the listener and preserves both ideas. Trust it reads as a complete verb phrase at the start of the second line.
